items.label: Description
items.value: A modern convention center in downtown Provo with natural light, mountain views, event managers, an in-house culinary team, a grand ballroom and a rooftop terrace.

items.label: Address
items.value: 220 W Center St, Provo, UT 84601

items.label: Style words
items.value:
Modern
Elegant
Flexible

items.label: Packages & add-ons
items.value:
Lunch Package — $41.95/person plus management charge and taxes: room rental, black or white chair covers and ties, 2 mid-length linens per banquet table, house centerpieces, TV or projector with small screen, microphone, audio connection, house sound, security attendant, event insurance (buffet; plated = 1 entrée)
Dinner Package — $49.95/person plus management charge and taxes: same as lunch plus floor-length linens with overlay, dance floor, staging, electrical, 2 gift/registration tables
Timpanogos Terrace — additional $1,500 (indoor backup space required)
Hosted or non-hosted bar with bartender (3 hours) — $300
Reception menu beverage additions — lemonade or agua fresca $35/gallon, coffee $36/gallon, sodas or bottled water $3 each, mocktails $6/person

items.label: Deposit
items.value:
Deposits accepted by credit card (Visa, AMEX, MC), ACH or check
Final meal guarantees due 7 business days before; menu selections due 21 days before

items.value: Grand Ballroom (Level 2)

items.label: Reception Menu 2026
items.value: Structure: Tier One hors d'oeuvres (select four), Tier Two (select one), infused water (select two) · Additions: Lemonade or agua fresca: $35/gallon · Coffee: $36/gallon · 12 oz sodas: $3 each · Bottled water: $3 each · Mocktails: $6/person · Pineapple tree with 200 fruit skewers: $400 · Hosted or non-hosted bar with bartender (3 hours): $300

items.label: Lunch Menu 2026
items.value: Structure: 1 salad, 2 dressings, 2 entrées, 1 starch, 1 vegetable, 1 dessert

items.value: Structure: 1 salad, 2 dressings, 2 entrées, 1 starch, 1 vegetable, 1 dessert

items.label: Sparklers allowed
items.value: Not listed by the venue

items.label: Restrictions
items.value:
Timpanogos Terrace requires paying for an indoor backup space ($1,500)
Outside food and beverage prohibited
No helium balloons, glitter, confetti or drones
Fog/smoke machines water-based only, 2 weeks notice, Fire Watch attendant required
Pyrotechnics only via licensed provider with Provo Fire approval

items.value: Limited disability parking in the attached lot

items.label: Accessibility
items.value:
All entrances wheelchair accessible (street level or ramp, automatic doors)
Four public elevators
All public restrooms ADA compliant
Limited accessible parking stalls in attached lot; more off site
ADA stage ramp on request (2 weeks notice)
Loaner wheelchairs (ID as collateral)

items.label: Parking
items.value:
UVCC Surface Lot (250 W 100 N): 24 free spaces
Freedom Surface Lot: $4/hr, $20 max; complimentary for up to 175 convention center guests (first come, register online)
Freedom Commons Garage: $2/hr, $12 max
Several other nearby public lots and garages

items.label: UVCC Surface Lot
items.value: Address: 250 W 100 N · Rate: Free · Spaces: 24

items.label: Freedom Commons Garage
items.value: Address: 165 W 200 N · Rate: $2/hr, $12 max · Spaces: 574

items.label: Notes
items.value:
Grand Ballroom 16,894 sq. ft., divisible into three sections of up to 380 guests each
Cascade Room 6,862 sq. ft. with rooftop Timpanogos Terrace on Level 3
Facility size: 83,578 sq. ft.
LEED Silver building; renovated 2022
